candidates.angle: Partha reminds Arjuna of his mother

en.intro: Listen for one word Krishna uses to stop Arjuna's eyes on the front line, before the arrows fly.
en.notice: Krishna says, pashya, behold. He does not say fight, or attack, or strike. He says only behold. He wants Arjuna to look, to see the faces, before he acts.
en.next: Krishna speaks to Arjuna in front of the kings, telling him to behold the assembled Kurus.
en.meaning: Standing before Bhishma, Drona, and all the rulers, Krishna said, "O Partha, behold these assembled Kurus."

hi.intro: सुनिए वह एक शब्द जो श्रीकृष्ण अर्जुन को युद्ध से पहले सामने देखने को कहते हैं।
hi.meaning: संजय कहते हैं, हे भरतवंशी राजन्, निद्राविजयी अर्जुन के द्वारा इस तरह कहने पर अन्तर्यामी भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण ने दोनों सेनाओं के मध्यभाग में पितामह भीष्म और आचार्य द्रोण के सामने तथा सम्पूर्ण राजाओं के सामने श्रेष्ठ रथको खड़ा करके इस तरह कहा कि हे पार्थ इन इकट्ठे हुए कुरुवंशियों को देख ॥
hi.notice: कृष्ण 'पश्य' कहते हैं। वे 'लड़ो' या 'हमला करो' नहीं कहते। वे केवल देखने को कहते हैं, ताकि अर्जुन कोई भी कदम उठाने से पहले उन चेहरों को देख ले।
hi.next: कृष्ण दोनों सेनाओं के बीच रथ रोककर राजाओं के सामने अर्जुन से कहते हैं कि इन इकट्ठे हुए कुरुवंशियों को देखो।

en.intro: Listen for one word Krishna uses to stop Arjuna's eyes on the front line, before the arrows fly.
en.body: Standing before Bhishma, Drona, and all the rulers, Krishna said, "O Partha, behold these assembled Kurus." Krishna says, pashya, behold. He does not say fight, or attack, or strike. He says only behold. He wants Arjuna to look, to see the faces, before he acts. Krishna speaks to Arjuna in front of the kings, telling him to behold the assembled Kurus.

issues: wrong_fact: "Arjuna looks and sees fathers, grandfathers, and teachers, all standing on the other side of the field." (The next verse (verse 26) describes Arjuna seeing these people, but this is the content of the next verse, not the current verse (25). The intro/notice incorrectly presents the content of the next verse as if it were in this verse.)

wrong_fact: "Krishna stops the chariot right in front of Bhishma and Drona, and tells Arjuna to look at the gathered kings." (This describes the action of the PREVIOUS verse (24), where Sanjaya states that Krishna stationed the chariot between the armies, which includes stopping before Bhishma and Drona. It does not describe the action of the current verse (25), which focuses on Krishna speaking to Arjuna after stopping the chariot.)
